gbm_population_evidence.quote: Novel Gamma-Delta (γδ)T Cell Therapy for Treatment of Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma
Must have histologically or cytologically confirmed glioblastoma multiforme prior to administration of the DRI γδ T cell injection.

candidate_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] DRI cell therapy: Drug Resistant Immunotherapy with gamma delta modified T cells to be resistance to temozolomide will be infused into the surgical cavity following the completion of standard concurrent radiation and chemotherapy with temozolomide.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Novel Gamma-Delta (γδ)T Cell Therapy for Treatment of Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: The cell therapy that is being used in this study is called gene-modified gamma delta T cells or Drug Resistant Immunotherapy (DRI).

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous gene-modified (MGMT-expressing, temozolomide-resistant) gamma delta T cell therapy, intracavitary

role_evidence.quote: The only arm will receive the DRI modified gamma delta T cells following standard therapy with radiation and temozolomide chemotherapy concurrent.

coder_notes: Only investigational intervention is a gene-modified gamma delta T cell therapy (excluded type). Temozolomide is standard chemoradiation/maintenance backbone, not a registered intervention but given to every patient. MGMT here refers to the transgene in the T cells, not a tumour biomarker.
